notes.text: The caption identifies the drawing as a pants-style decomposition of a triangulated map. Its coined adjective ends in -esque; the single/double n remains uncertain. The two drawings and caption are reproduced in one common coordinate frame to retain their positions on the leaf. Editorial coordinate letters are not printed.

The left drawing has eleven junctions and twenty-three distinct finite endpoint joins, with seven exterior rays. Both visible c--f pencil traces are retained. A face walk on the simple endpoint-incidence model returned thirteen triangular bounded faces and a seven-edge outer boundary, with 11-23+14=2. This is a conditional consistency check of that incidence model, not a claim that two physical traces must represent two different edges or a reason to identify the doubtful small mark.

The right drawing has eight vertices, nine finite edges including its loop, and six exterior rays. Counting the loop twice at its vertex gives degree three at every vertex. Its connected finite core has first Betti number 9-8+1=2. Twenty-three numeric annotations are visible; no number is supplied for the third local branch at the lower-left fork. The calculation does not impose a compatibility rule on the written numbers.

The separate 1 and 9 below the upper right-graph vertex are local branch annotations, not one number 19. The two ends of other edges can carry different nearby numbers, so the transcription preserves every local placement. The leaf contains no written theorem or numerical rule that would justify changing them.

The red geometry uses colour-separated vector outlines after visual reading, with manually traced thin paths along four specific source-visible continuous stretches that the initial threshold omitted. The actual small enclosure openings remain. The local upper-left tip and rightward-ray thickening are also vector shapes. A clipped fragment of the nearby numeral 5 was excluded from the ray mask because the complete 5 is separately typeset. Filtered mask-to-polygon export was checked for pixel equality; this production check is not a mathematical proof. The drawing remains an explicit TikZ approximation, with evidence crops and generators retained. No TeX engine was invoked.

check_events.outcome: Actually ran proposed/148_scan072_incidence_check.py. The left rotation-system face walk traversed all 46 directed incidences of the 23 distinct endpoint joins, obtaining thirteen triangles and a seven-edge outer face, with Euler value 2. The doubled physical trace is stored separately. The result is in proposed/148_scan072_incidence_check.json.

The same retained script counted eight right-graph vertices, nine finite edges including the loop and six rays, verified connectedness of the finite core and degree three at all vertices after counting the loop twice, and computed first Betti number 2. It did not check or infer any arithmetic relation among the twenty-three written annotations.
